title: Federation: blob fetches not covered by signing
description: Receivers fetch attachment blobs from the sending peer's URLs; sh60's signing rule covers Peer/* requests only. Decide whether blob fetches are signed (receiver as client) or authorised another way (capability URLs), and specify it. Follow-up to jmap-chat-spec-sh60 (peer auth via RFC 9421 signatures, approved 2026-10-19).
close_reason: Option (a): blob fetches from fetchUrl are RFC 9421-signed GETs; serving server verifies, SHOULD serve only to peer domains it sent the fetchUrl to (grant recorded before sending), 404 otherwise; no cross-origin redirects. Avatar fetch gap split to jmap-chat-spec-6gw4.
